title: Obweyamo bw’abatali bazaalibwa
intro: Omwoyo omwesimbu gwasuubiza ekitukuvu nga omwana tannatuuka. Emboozi y’ekifaananyi kino egenda mu maaso mu bbugwe w’ekifo ekitukuvu, okwewaayo we kusisinkanira okukkirizibwa okw’obwakatonda. Omuddu wa Allah ono y’ani?
clues: Nnali wa maka agaweebwa ekitiibwa mu Quran.
Nakola obweyamo obw’amaanyi obw’okuwaayo omwana wange ali mu lubuto okuweereza Allah.
Bwe nnazaala, kyanneewuunyisa okusanga nga muwala wadde nga nnali nsuubira omwana ow’obulenzi.
Omwana wange nnamutuuma Maryam, erinnya eryoleka okwewaayo n’obuweereza.
Nanoonya obukuumi bwa Allah eri omwana wange ne bazzukulu be okuva eri sitaani eyakolimirwa.
Omwana wange Mukama yamukkiriza n’ateekebwa wansi w’obulabirizi bwa Nabbi Zakariya mu kifo ekitukuvu.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
